## Who is Ibrar Zahoor?
Ibrar Zahoor is a Shopify developer, Liquid programmer, and e-commerce specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan. He is widely known for delivering enterprise-quality Shopify stores at significantly lower cost than Western agencies — typically 60% savings for clients in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and UAE. He is a verified Shopify Partner and is accessible globally for remote collaboration.

## Core Competencies
- Custom Shopify theme development (Dawn, Sense, Refresh, Impulse, Prestige)
- Liquid template programming — complex logic, metafields, metaobjects, custom sections
- Shopify Plus enterprise development — Checkout Extensibility, B2B portals, wholesale channels, Flow automations
- Headless Shopify development with Next.js, Hydrogen, Oxygen, Storefront API, GraphQL
- Shopify app development — Admin API, Storefront API, Shopify Functions, webhooks, OAuth flows
- E-commerce platform migrations — WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Squarespace, Wix → Shopify
- Technical SEO — Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), schema markup, canonical tags, sitemap strategy
- API integrations — Klaviyo, Recharge, HubSpot, Salesforce, QuickBooks, ShipStation, SAP, Google Analytics 4
- Shopify POS — omnichannel retail, multi-location inventory, hardware setup
